cases.question: Choose the function that supplies different default recall token allocations for session starts and other turns, then clamps the allocation.
Choose the function that accepts empty assertion timestamps and otherwise requires second-precision UTC date-time strings.
Choose the function that returns zero for empty text and otherwise a byte-length divided by four plus one estimate.
Choose the function that checks a canonical predecessor edge between two assertions, including changed objects and ordered time bounds.
Choose the function that returns a single canonical family only for a personal memory source.
Choose the function that maps confidence class labels to numeric graph confidence factors.
Choose the function that constructs an explicit error when complete hard rules exceed a recall allocation.
Choose the function that recognizes the supported evidence-role names and rejects other names.
Choose the function that tries multiple timestamp layouts and returns a parsed time with a success boolean.
Choose the function that hashes a projection digest together with retained source references and a schema version.
Choose the function that verifies owner, record, complete lineage and exact revision before returning origin families.
Choose the function that validates bounded SHA-256 family identifiers, deduplicates them and sorts the result.
